items.name: beacon.sh
items.tagline: Open-source self-improving memory for AI coding agents
items.description: Beacon turns agent sessions across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and 20+ other harnesses into a compounding knowledge layer, so every agent starts smarter than the last. It captures every agent trace across your environment and turns activity into clear operational visibility. Get started for free at beacon.sh

items.name: Xmind 2027
items.tagline: Your mind map is now an AI thinking partner
items.description: As information becomes easier to access, understanding and judgment matter more than ever. Xmind 2027 gives you and AI a shared visual space to work through ideas. With Xmind Agent, use your local documents and maps to research, develop ideas, and weigh possibilities through conversation. Your map evolves with your thinking. With MCP, bring that same context into ChatGPT, Claude, and your existing AI workflow, while you stay in control of the direction.

items.name: UnleashX
items.tagline: The AI workforce that turns conversations into outcomes.
items.description: UnleashX lets you hire AI employees like people - pick a role, connect your CRM and tools, set your rules, and hand over the work. Execute workflows end-to-end, with humans stepping in only when needed.

items.name: Cedric AI for Meetings
items.tagline: The first AI agent to present your slides and attend for you
items.description: Send Cedric to your Zoom, Meet, or Teams calls. He presents your slides, and answers questions using live data from your tools. Join late? He catches you up. Can’t join? He represents you. Afterwards, approve the notes and follow-ups, and he handles the work.

items.name: Hera
items.description: Generate images, design, and animate on one canvas. Direct multiple AI agents at the same time. Stay in control with editable layers. Make ads, launch videos, and social posts in your own brand. Paste your website to get your brand kit. Write a few prompts and get dozens of on-brand ads side by side. Drop in any ad you like as a reference, fix details with feedback or by hand, then animate your best ones into motion ads. Resize to every format, all on the same board.

items.name: Clayzo
items.tagline: Create animations and motion design with your coding agent
items.description: Clayzo makes it incredibly easy for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to create web animations and motion graphics. Your agent writes it in code and reviews every frame; you export a video or play it live on your site. And it’s free!

items.name: Display 1.0
items.tagline: Create docs and apps with any agent, in one workspace
items.description: Create and collaborate on docs, prototypes and apps with your team. Store the files your agents make, organise knowledge work in Spaces and Folders, and turn it all into your internal knowledge base. Work with any agent and any plan, at a flat price.

items.name: Self-Growing Websites by Greta.sh
items.tagline: Build a website that can do its own SEO & AEO automatically
items.description: You built a website/app, so why is nobody visiting? Getting found on Google & AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity etc takes months of SEO & AEO. Self-Growing Websites fix that. Greta.sh finds what customers search for, writes pages that answer them, and gets you showing up on Google, ChatGPT & everywhere With the Greta.sh MCP, you can run it all from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: just ask it to build, grow, publish or report. Don't just build a website anymore, build a customer magnet with Greta.sh!

items.name: Agent Inbox
items.tagline: Give your agent an email address, Slack and Telegram handle
items.description: Agent Inbox gives every AI agent its own email address, Slack handle and Telegram handle, all behind one API. Message your agent from wherever you already work, and it replies in the same thread. It works with Claude, Grok, OpenAI, Hermes and any other agent framework. No more glue code for each channel: your agent gets one inbox, and you get one place to reach it.

items.name: Hyperresearch
items.description: Hyperresearch does the research and shows the evidence. Ask a question, get a cited report; each cited claim is checked against its source, and all sources are kept in a searchable vault. On the DRACO benchmark, we are the world's number-one research agent. New: Answers MCP and API. Your agent calls ask and gets a short answer with word-for-word quotes, or a simple "not found" instead of a hallucination. We combine 4 AI search engines and 40+ other data sources for the widest and deepest access.

items.name: Help
items.tagline: The app designed for targeted and transparent help
items.description: Help is a global charity platform, connecting donors, nonprofit organizations, and businesses to make meaningful change accessible to everyone. Built around the values of love, respect, compassion, technology, transparency, and safety, Help enables targeted and accountable giving in support of people, animals, and the planet. Fundraisers on the platform are led by a network of verified nonprofit partners, helping donors understand where their contributions go and the impact they support.

items.name: Friday Work
items.tagline: When Claude hits its limit, your task keeps going
items.description: Other tools run agents side by side. Friday makes them work together: when Claude runs out mid-task, another agent you already run picks it up with the progress so far, and agents message each other instead of you copy-pasting between terminals.

items.name: Looper
items.tagline: If Grok Bot supported team collaboration and was Open Source
items.description: An AI hire for one number you care about. It works daily in Gmail, GitHub, Search Console and the rest, asks your team before anything goes out, and gets a 1:1 every two weeks to improve. Open source. Runs free on the ChatGPT or Grok plan you already pay for.

items.name: diff-tour
items.tagline: AI writes the code. Learn to read it like a senior engineer.
items.description: Now that AI writes the code, what should engineers learn? Understanding code still matters, and understanding code means learning how a senior engineer thinks. diff-tour turns a git diff into a tour you step through with → and ←: what the change is for, where to look, what a senior asks (what if it runs twice? can it roll back?), what must be fixed and what is a nit, and where they'd say "wait", asked as questions so you guess first. Runs on your AI coding CLI. Read-only, open source.

items.name: CuriousLM
items.tagline: Private AI that runs on your device. No account.
items.description: CuriousLM is a free AI app that runs the model on your phone or computer, so your chats are written and kept there, encrypted. No account, no chat server. Words the model was unsure of stay underlined: tap one to see what else it nearly said, and take the answer another way. Voice and Pocket Wikipedia run on the device too, and on Android it can tell you who is waiting on you, with your permission.

items.name: Linkly AI Clipper
items.tagline: Save web as an Agent-friendly Markdown browser extension
items.description: One click turns the page you are on into cleanly formatted Markdown that you can preview, copy or download right from the side panel. Simple, lightweight, and everything it saves is optimised for AI agents to use.

items.name: redu.cloud
items.tagline: Run machines at agent speed, not human speed.
items.description: redu.cloud is a cloud made for AI agents, with a generous free tier. It allows your agents to get the stateful resources they need extremely fast, making them ideal for doing deployments of your app, DevOps, training stateful AI models and fixing live incidents at agent speed, safely.

items.name: Widgeteer
items.tagline: Describe a widget, get a working one on your site
items.description: Type what you need, like "a cleaning quote calculator" or "a table booking form", and Widgeteer builds a working widget. Edit it by hand or by asking. Submissions go to email, Zapier, n8n or a webhook. Works on WordPress, Shopify and any website.
